data: Microsoft reported fiscal 2023 net income of about $72.4 billion (fiscal year ended June 30, 2023), while Amazon reported net income of about $30.4 billion for calendar-year 2023 (fiscal year ended December 31, 2023). Microsoft's figure was therefore roughly 2.4 times Amazon's ($72.4 billion divided by $30.4 billion is about 2.38). Note that the two companies' fiscal years end at different times, so the periods are not perfectly aligned. Amazon's 2023 profit also rebounded sharply from a net loss of $2.7 billion in 2022, whereas Microsoft's rose modestly from $72.7 billion in fiscal 2022 to $72.4 billion, essentially flat to slightly down.
